required.quote: Each section of the examining board may establish continuing education requirements for renewal of a credential issued by that section under this chapter.

available.quote: The appropriate section of the examining board may, upon application and the payment of the required fee, grant a certificate of registration as an architect, as a landscape architect, or as a professional engineer to any person who holds an unexpired certificate of similar registration issued to the person by the proper authority in any state or territory or possession of the United States or in any country in which the requirements for the registration of architects, landscape architects, or professional engineers are of a standard not lower than specified in this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an unexpired certificate of similar registration from any U.S. state, territory, or possession, or any country with requirements not lower than Wisconsin's, and pay the required fee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration or a certificate of record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration or a certificate of record.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or impressing seal or stamp upon documents not prepared by the registrant or knowingly permitting seal/stamp to be used by another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing or impressing his or her seal or stamp upon documents not prepared by him or her or under his or her control or knowingly permitting his or her seal or stamp to be used by any other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting the unauthorized practice of architecture or professional engineering by unregistered persons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting the unauthorized practice of architecture or professional engineering by persons not registered under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of architecture as a registered architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of architecture as a registered architect, of landscape architecture as a registered landscape architect or of professional engineering as a registered professional engineer, or in the professional activity of a holder of a certificate of record as engineer-in-training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the rules of professional conduct adopted and promulgated by the relevant section of the examining board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the rules of professional conduct adopted and promulgated by that section of the examining board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or adjudication of mental incompetency by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322 and 111.335, or adjudication of mental incompetency by a court of competent jurisdiction, a certified copy of the record of conviction or adjudication of incompetency to be conclusive evidence of such conviction or incompetency.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No individual architect registered under this chapter may practice or offer to practice architecture, as a principal, officer, employee, or agent of a firm, partnership, or corporation unless all of the following are satisfied: ... The firm, partnership, or corporation has been issued a certificate of authorization under sub. (3) (a) 1.

definition_quote.value: The practice of architecture includes any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, architectural and structural design, or responsible supervision of construction, in connection with the construction of any private or public buildings, structures, projects, or the equipment thereof, or addition to or alterations thereof, in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of architecture" includes any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, architectural and structural design, or responsible supervision of construction, in connection with the construction of any private or public buildings, structures, projects, or the equipment thereof, or addition to or alterations thereof, in which the public welfare or the safeguarding of life, health or property is concerned or involved.

methods_authorized.quote: any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, architectural and structural design, or responsible supervision of construction

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: The registered interior designer section of the examining board shall register as a Wisconsin registered interior designer an individual who submits an application to the registered interior designer section

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Practice of interior design" means the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or interior construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements

permitted_firm_structures.quote: The practice of architecture pertaining to the internal operations of a firm, partnership, or corporation may be performed by employees if the architectural services are performed by or under the direct supervision of architects registered under this chapter

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.value: All personnel who practice or offer to practice in its behalf as architects must be registered
firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: All personnel who practice or offer to practice in its behalf as architects are registered under this chapter.

seal_required.quote: All final drawings, specifications, plans, reports, or other architectural papers or documents involving the practice of architecture, prepared for the use of a firm, partnership, or corporation, for delivery by it to any person, or for public record within the state shall be dated and bear the signature and seal of the architect who was in responsible charge of their preparation.

continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: Any rules a section of the examining board promulgates under sub. (1) shall exempt a credential holder whose credential is classified as retired status under par. (a) from continuing education requirements.
